summary: Live blog of the IPL 2024 auction held on December 19, 2023 at Coca-Cola Arena, Dubai. It was a record-breaking day: Pat Cummins went to SRH for Rs 20.50 Cr, then Mitchell Starc to KKR for Rs 24.75 Cr, and uncapped Indians like Shubham Dubey and Sameer Rizvi also landed big deals. In total 72 players, including 30 overseas, were sold for Rs 230.45 Cr.
one_line: Live blog of the IPL 2024 Dubai auction, where Mitchell Starc (Rs 24.75 Cr) and Pat Cummins (Rs 20.50 Cr) set new price records.
key_facts: The IPL 2024 auction took place on Tuesday, December 19, 2023 at Coca-Cola Arena, Dubai, starting at 1:00 PM IST.
333 players went under the hammer for only 77 slots, of which 30 were overseas slots.
Pat Cummins was bought by Sunrisers Hyderabad for Rs 20.50 Cr, becoming the most expensive IPL player at that time.
Cummins' record lasted about 30 minutes: Kolkata Knight Riders paid Rs 24.75 Cr for Mitchell Starc after a bidding war involving GT, MI and DC.
For the first time two players crossed the Rs 20 Cr mark; both were Australian pacers.
A total of 72 players, including 30 overseas, were sold for Rs 230.45 Cr combined.
Uncapped Shubham Dubey joined Rajasthan Royals for Rs 5.8 Cr and Sameer Rizvi went to CSK for Rs 8.4 Cr after bidding with GT and DC.
Daryl Mitchell went to CSK for Rs 14 Cr, Harshal Patel to PBKS for Rs 11.75 Cr, and Alzarri Joseph to RCB for Rs 11.50 Cr.
Gujarat Titans paid Rs 10 Cr for Spencer Johnson, and Rovman Powell went to RR for Rs 7.4 Cr.
Travis Head went to SRH for Rs 6.8 Cr, Harry Brook to DC for Rs 4 Cr, and Rachin Ravindra to CSK for Rs 1.8 Cr.
Steve Smith, Josh Hazlewood, Adil Rashid and Sarfaraz Khan went unsold.
Before the auction, GT had the biggest purse at Rs 38.15 crore and LSG the smallest at Rs 13.15 crore; RR had Rs 90 L left at the end.
Kumar Kushagra went to DC for Rs 7.2 Cr and Shahrukh Khan to GT for Rs 7.4 Cr.
The IPL 2024 window was to start on March 22, and Mallika Sagar was the auctioneer.
